record.question: Which is the most crowded city in the world according to World Economic Forum?
record.explanation: Answer A: Dhaka. The question’s named publisher, World Economic Forum, states in its 20 March 2018 article that Dhaka is the most crowded city. Historical/source note: This is the named historical ranking and its urban-area definitions, not a universal present density ranking across every possible city boundary. Reference: https://www.weforum.org/stories/2018/03/these-are-the-world-s-most-densely-populated-places/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
